spans.quote: As we know, the equation Ax = b may have no solution. The vector Ax is always in the column space of A, and b is unlikely to be in the column space. So, we project b onto a vector p in the column space of A and solve Ax̂ = p.
spans.why: 这三句话是正文“先找最近点 p，再求参数 x̂”的英文原型，可以对照着读。

spans.quote: [25:12] And the key is that b minus A x-hat, that's the error. [25:24] Is perpendicular to the plane. [26:31] So really I have the equations a one transpose b minus Ax is zero. And also a two transpose b minus Ax is zero. [27:43] So the equation I'm coming up with is A transpose (b − A x-hat) is zero.
spans.why: 这一段与正文“法方程”一小节的推理顺序相同：先说残差垂直于平面，再逐列写出正交条件，最后合成矩阵形式。

spans.quote: [20:12] They don't have to be perpendicular. [20:15] But they better be independent, because then that tells me the plane.
spans.why: Strang 在这里默认 A 的两列线性无关，于是法方程有唯一解。正文“点唯一，参数未必唯一”讨论的正是去掉这个前提以后会发生什么。

spans.quote: [37:51] …has too many rows, it's just got a couple of columns, like a one and a two, but lots of rows. Not square. [38:02] And if it's not square, this A transpose A is square but I can't pull it apart like this [38:10] I'm not allowed to do this pull apart, except if A was square.
spans.why: 概念检测第 1(3) 题考查的就是这个错误。听完这一段再判断，会更清楚错在哪里。

spans.quote: More rigorously, if XᵀX is invertible, then the matrix X(XᵀX)⁻¹Xᵀ represents orthogonal projection onto the column space of X.
spans.why: 与正文中投影矩阵 P = A(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ 的定义对应。注意原文同样带着“XᵀX 可逆”这一前提。

spans.quote: 如果 eᵀv≠0，取 t 与 eᵀv 同号且 |t| 足够小，p+tv 就比 p 更靠近 b，这与 p 是最近点矛盾。

spans.quote: 如果 A 的列向量线性相关，就存在非零向量 d 使 Ad=0，此时 x̂ 与 x̂+d 给出同一个点 p，参数便有无穷多组。
